scope: Isolated plugin lookup candidate; bounded original/JVM/rebuilt body comparison and structural signed APK proof. No Android plugin/network/scheduler or whole-application parity claim. Parent combined acceptance is separate.

coverage_fault_scope.purpose: Exercise only the original defensive return-null after a deliberately returning e6d.r boundary; ordinary invalid labels must throw the original exception.

compared: exact injected/external messages, including injected NPE and CCE
exception_comparison.excluded: Only VM-generated null/cast exception wording. No injected message exclusion. Caught identity is compared only where observable through exposed dependency effects.

literal_retry_behavior: Each fresh request selects API key index zero and stores zero into both continuation integer fields. Restored nonzero retry flags persist where the original retains them. Finite scripted sequences do not prove termination for an endless external failure stream.

linkage_proof.scope:
Check migrated invocation kinds and private/static accesses against original declarations.

This is a bounded static check, NOT the ART verifier. It does not prove Android API
availability, protected/package access, receiver dataflow or classloader behavior.
The separate validate_migration.py checks signatures and external-reference provenance.

reference_marker_inventory.scope: Exact-signature metadata inventory; compilation and behavior have separate checks

staging_diagnostic.retry: Only isolated generated build/java was removed in a separate completed operation. Fresh standard three-way execution passed. Environmental cause remains unproven; no stale-Dex or exist_ok bypass.

prior_inactive_checkpoints.scope: Zero mismatches but correctly failed instruction/edge coverage.
Original/JVM coverage passed; signed/control proof pending.
Signed proof and independent roundtrip passed; controls pending.

merge_boundaries: Do not replace parent build.py or runtime files. Apply narrow test_v9 and UI-control patches while retaining parent changes. Other paths require baseline hash checks. No source edits after this freeze.
